标题: Life Cycle Assessment of PBAT-PLA Biodegradable Packaging Films
作者: Zhang Wei; Li Ming; Chen Hong
关键词: PBAT; PLA; Life Cycle Assessment; Biodegradable film; Monte Carlo
摘要: This study aims to quantify the environmental impacts of PBAT-PLA biodegradable packaging films using life cycle assessment. We apply Monte Carlo simulation to analyze uncertainty across end-of-life scenarios. Results show that industrial composting reduces global warming potential by 32% compared with landfill.

标题: Deep Learning for PM2.5 Concentration Prediction: A Case Study of Hunan Province
作者: Wang Lei; Liu Yang; Zhou Na
期刊/会议: IEEE International Conference on Environmental Informatics
关键词: PM2.5; Deep Learning; LSTM; Air Quality; Forecasting
摘要: We propose an LSTM-based deep learning model to predict PM2.5 concentrations across 14 cities in Hunan Province. Results indicate that the hybrid LSTM model outperforms traditional statistical baselines with a 15% lower RMSE.
